raw_text: Replying to the Arunachal Pradesh invasion thread: People forget that China's western theater command has been reorganized specifically for high-altitude operations. But the logistics challenge of projecting force across the Tibetan Plateau to Arunachal is enormous. I think the real risk is limited land grabs, not a full invasion. Again, this is pure speculation - I have zero insider knowledge.
clean_text: Speculative analysis of PLA western theater capabilities for Arunachal operations. Discusses logistics challenges across Tibetan Plateau. Author disclaims any insider knowledge.
